watchOut: Its own text and its table do not agree on light jet pricing.
name: JetFinder
roleBasis: Says it matches you "from our network of over 25,000 aircraft". Its pages also show an "Our Fleet" gallery and a jet card. The pages we read do not say plainly whether it owns or operates aircraft.
summary: Aircraft network with a cost page that shows starting hourly prices by class.
differentiator: Publishes "From" hourly prices for six classes, from $4,000 for a turboprop to $14,000 for an ultra long range jet. Its own text on the same page says rentals run "$2,000 to $15,000+" an hour and uses a $2,000-an-hour light jet in an example, while its table starts light jets at $4,500.
priceNote: Starting hourly prices by class, plus route price ranges on the cost page. The page does not say what the starting prices include.
operatorDisclosure: Not stated on the pages we read.
bestFor: Buyers who want a quick starting price per class.
skipIf: You need to know what the starting price includes, or whether JetFinder operates aircraft itself.
